race.comment: LEGASELLI (7) was campaigned like a good horse in her debut campaign, tackling the Baillieu before the break. Her two trials this time in suggest she hasn't gone backwards and this is a massive drop in class. Looks primed for a strong showing. SAVVY DIAMOND (8) is on debut today after a handy trial win at Rosehill most recently. She was impressive there over the longer 1030m journey and she she ticks plenty of boxes from the astute yard from the inside barrier. Can make an immediate impact. STRONGHOLD (5) showed enough on debut despite going under as the race fave. He will be better for that run however as he did show some inexperience in the straight. Can fire now with the run under his belt. WRITTEN IN MUNNY (6) has shown plenty at the trials and won't be far away.
